description: This file contains test scripts for verifying the functionality of git's signed commit import/export features, including handling of various signature formats (OpenPGP, X.509, SSH) and different signature validity scenarios. It involves setting up repositories, creating signed commits, exporting/importing commits, and checking signature preservation or removal.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in output.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the specified repository.
